baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative نُهْلِكِ governs ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ inside the confirmatory question أَلَمْ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ruin branch of ه ل ك supplies caused destruction, while the precedence branch of ء و ل identifies a temporally prior cohort. The negative interrogative presents that destruction as an acknowledged precedent rather than new information.

activation_trace.role: Falling into ruin and extinction supplies the destructive result caused by نُهْلِكِ.
Beginning and precedence makes ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ the former or earliest cohort used as precedent.

changed_reading.before: A neutral notice that some earlier people are gone.
changed_reading.after: A rhetorical appeal to an acknowledged act in which the speaker caused the former cohort's ruin.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ permits the mapped ء و ل image of return to outcome beside نُهْلِكِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The people called first are viewed not only by starting position but by the outcome to which their course returned. Their destruction makes the beginning legible through its مآل, folding temporal priority into completed consequence.

activation_trace.role: Ruin and extinction provide the terminal state of the former cohort's course.
Return to outcome or final meaning turns firstness into a trajectory disclosed by its end.

changed_reading.before: First merely labels an older chronological group.
changed_reading.after: The former group's ruin is the disclosed outcome of a course, so their beginning functions as a completed precedent.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The split mapping of ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ reaches the و ل ي image of one thing following another.
baseline_models.mechanism: On the non-dominant mapping, firstness can mark a position in continuous succession. Destruction then belongs to the leading link of a possible series, not necessarily to a sealed remote class.

activation_trace.role: Ruin and extinction supply the event that may recur along a sequence.
Continuous one-after-another succession recasts the former ones as the leading position in a chain.

changed_reading.before: The verse points backward to one isolated ancient group.
changed_reading.after: The former ones may be the first links in a serial pattern of destruction.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: نُهْلِكِ has a family-ruin branch, while the dominant ء و ل inventory includes household and dependents.
baseline_models.mechanism: Two focus branches allow the object to be heard socially: predecessor households and those who return to them lose the structure that sustains the family. This is more specific than counting individual deaths.

activation_trace.role: Being ruined in, or bringing ruin upon, one's family supplies household-level collapse.
A person's household and dependents supply the social unit carried by the former ones.

changed_reading.before: Destruction is only the death of many separate persons.
changed_reading.after: The verse can weakly evoke the collapse of ancestral households and their dependent order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent sequence says that later ones are made to follow the former ones and then generalizes, 'thus We do with the criminals.' The focus destruction becomes the first realized instance of a repeatable, class-conditioned operation.

activation_trace.role: Ruin and extinction anchor the operation whose recurrence is activated by the following ayat.
Continuous succession supplies the latent serial structure of the former ones.
Loyal succession and one-after-another following make the later cohort continue the first cohort's path.
Laterness after the first names the second temporal pole of the sequence.
Bringing about an act turns the adjacent example into an asserted mode of repeated agency.
Crime and offense define the class to which the repeated operation applies.

structural_cues: ثُمَّ marks succession and كَذَٰلِكَ converts the paired cohorts into a rule.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies former/later succession, repeated doing, and criminality; I infer a continuing rule from their adjacency. A live alternative is a finite two-cohort warning rather than an indefinitely repeatable law.

changed_reading.before: The focus recalls a closed destruction confined to the past.
changed_reading.after: The former ones are the first instance in a sequence that overtakes later criminals as well.

context_deltas.mechanism: Judicial separation, repeated attribution of falsehood, criminality, and recompense turn the destruction into an adjudicated consequence. The earlier cohort functions as evidentiary precedent inside a judgment frame, not as a random casualty list.

activation_trace.role: Caused ruin supplies the sanction whose framing is changed by the context.
Temporal precedence lets the former ones serve as an earlier case.
Judgment that separates truth from falsehood supplies the juridical setting.
Attributing something or its bearer to falsehood names the repeatedly charged conduct.
Crime and offense classify the recipients of the destructive act.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies the surah's explicit consequence logic.

structural_cues: The focus is immediately preceded and followed by the same woe-to-deniers refrain.
Day of separation language precedes the focus, while 'thus We do with criminals' follows it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies judgment, denial, crime, and matched recompense; I infer that these are the grounds and legal shape of the destruction. The alternative is that they classify the audience without specifying how the former ones were destroyed.

changed_reading.before: The verse displays overwhelming force against an earlier population.
changed_reading.after: The verse cites an earlier adjudicated consequence as precedent for deniers and criminals.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated أَلَمْ questions coordinate destruction with creation from generative water, stable placement to a measured limit, and earth's containment of living and dead. Destruction becomes the terminal transition in a bounded material lifecycle rather than an isolated interruption of it.

activation_trace.role: Ruin, loss, and death anchor the terminal transition being repositioned within a lifecycle.
Bringing creation into existence supplies the lifecycle's entry operation.
Male generative fluid in the womb supplies the material beginning of embodied life.
Fixity and settlement provide the stable intermediate placement.
A measure that reaches its limit supplies bounded duration and development.
Gathering and enclosing in a receptacle makes earth the containing medium.
Living, ensouled creatures name one state held by the earth.
Loss of life and power names the corresponding terminal state held by the same earth.

structural_cues: 77:16, 77:20, and 77:25 all open with أَلَمْ and first-person plural acts.
The sequence moves from former destruction to present creation, measured gestation, and earth containing alive and dead.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the parallel questions and the create-place-measure-contain states; I infer that their formal coordination presents one governed lifecycle. They may alternatively be separate proofs of power with no claim that destruction itself is lifecycle management.

changed_reading.before: Destruction abruptly cancels an otherwise independent human history.
changed_reading.after: Destruction is one bounded transition within the same ordering that creates, places, measures, and contains life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact former group destroyed in the focus is later named as an object of gathering together with the current addressees. Their destruction therefore cannot function as simple loss of all recoverable identity; it is a change of state before collective re-presentation.

activation_trace.role: The broad ruin branch includes extinction, the maximal reading that the later gathering constrains.
Precedence identifies the focus object whose identity is tracked forward.
Joining the dispersed into a collected whole supplies the later operation upon that group.
The repeated former-ones label resolves the gathered object as the same class named in the focus.

structural_cues: 77:38 coordinates current addressees and former ones as joint objects of gathering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact lexical recurrence and gathering; I infer continuity of group identity across destruction. Reconstitution rather than continuous persistence remains a live account, but either blocks an absolute-erasure reading.

changed_reading.before: To destroy the former ones is to erase them beyond further participation.
changed_reading.after: Their earthly order ends, yet they remain identifiable and gatherable with later addressees.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sending, reminder, excuse, and warning establish a communication phase; repeated denial answers it. Later, speech and permission to excuse are closed, and the surah ends by asking what renewed discourse could produce trust. The focus destruction becomes the closure of an exhausted testimony process.

activation_trace.role: Caused ruin supplies the endpoint whose communicative preconditions are reconstructed.
Messenger and message supply an initiated act of communication.
A reminder that makes one remember supplies recoverable notice rather than hidden grounds.
Excuse and exculpation supply the possibility that notice clears liability.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the adverse function of the same communication.
Charging the message or messenger with falsehood supplies the recurrent failed response.
Speech itself supplies the capacity explicitly absent at the later endpoint.
Permission to act, here denied, marks closure of the opportunity to offer an excuse.
Speech renewed as news tests whether any further discourse could alter the response.
Heart-settling assent supplies the response that no later discourse is expected to achieve.

structural_cues: Excuse/warning precedes the promised event, while speech/excuse is disabled after judgment.
The repeated denial refrain culminates in the final question about any discourse after this one.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a message-response-closure sequence; I infer that exhausted communication licenses the focus destruction. A live alternative is that these speech motifs frame judgment without describing the causal path of the former peoples' ruin.

changed_reading.before: The former ones are destroyed in a bare exercise of force.
changed_reading.after: Their destruction is recalled as the closure reached after message, reminder, warning, and persistent denial.

context_deltas.mechanism: The effort-exhaustion branch of ه ل ك combines with an appointed endpoint, a measure reaching its limit, benefit extended to a terminus, and littleness. A cohort's destruction can thus be pictured as being spent through a finite allowance rather than only being struck at one instant.

activation_trace.role: Exhausting effort, including a road exhausting its traveler, supplies depletion as a mode of destruction.
A fixed temporal endpoint supplies the outer boundary of the expenditure.
A quantity reaching its limit makes the allowance measurable rather than indefinite.
Extension that reaches its terminus supplies temporary continuation before exhaustion.
Smallness and scarcity sharply limit the apparent interval of enjoyment.

structural_cues: Appointment to a day, measured gestation, and 'enjoy a little' distribute limit language across the surah.
The focus lies between the appointed day sequence and later explicit short-term allowance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies endpoint, measure, extension, and littleness; I infer a depletion trajectory and map it onto the focus exhaustion branch. These temporal cues may instead concern separate events and leave destruction abrupt.

changed_reading.before: Destruction is a punctual blow from outside the cohort's duration.
changed_reading.after: Destruction may also be the exhaustion of a measured, briefly extended allowance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers a rainless-land branch of ه ل ك to the destruction of peoples. It remains anchored directly in نُهْلِكِ and is activated by a coherent rain, fertile-earth, life/death, and sweet-water system; downstream prose should call it an ecological analogy, not assert drought as the historical cause.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: نُهْلِكِ cites the ه ل ك branch 'barren land with no rain.'

activation_trace.role: Rainless barren land supplies ecological incapacity as an exploratory image of destruction.
Dry herbage revived by rain supplies the reversible ecological process opposed to barrenness.
Water itself supplies the material whose presence sustains the life system.
Soft productive earth supplies the viable habitat that barrenness would reverse.
Earth's life through rain and vegetation ties vitality to water availability.
Dead land or matter supplies the ecologically inactive state.
Making water available supplies active maintenance of the habitat.
Fresh sweet water specifies the sustaining quality whose loss would make land destructive.

changed_reading.before: To destroy the former ones means only to kill their members.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, destruction can mean collapsing the water-land capacity that keeps a people and its habitat alive.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the focus verb is causative while the activated ه ل ك image is greedy craving. It remains anchored in that focus branch and in the later desire, eating, brief enjoyment, and criminality sequence; render it only as a secondary account of the pathway into ruin, while retaining divine causation as the focus grammar.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: نُهْلِكِ carries the ه ل ك branch of greedy craving and jostling for appetite.

activation_trace.role: Greedy craving and grasping supply a self-consuming dynamic inside the focus destruction root.
Crime supplies the moral classification later joined to temporary consumption.
The soul's pull toward what it desires supplies appetite's motivating force.
Eating supplies the bodily act through which the appetite image becomes concrete.
Pleasurable benefit supplies the temporary gratification that feeds the dynamic.
Littleness limits gratification and exposes its inability to prevent ruin.

changed_reading.before: Destruction arrives wholly from outside the former peoples.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, divine destruction also realizes an appetite-driven course in which brief consumption spends its subjects toward ruin.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it moralizes the mountain-pride branch and the rare abyss branch of ر ك ع. It stays anchored in the focus's destructive-abyss branch and the explicit refusal to bow; downstream prose should present the high-to-low reversal as a spatial wordplay, not a settled causal interpretation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: نُهْلِكِ carries the image of a destructive abyss or wilderness where a traveler falls.

activation_trace.role: A deadly precipice or wilderness supplies the downward endpoint of destruction.
Raising the nose in pride supplies the exploratory image of self-elevation.
Bending and lowering the head supplies the vertical act explicitly refused.
An abyss in the earth echoes the focus precipice and supplies the forced low endpoint.

changed_reading.before: Destruction has no spatial relation to the subjects' posture.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, those who refuse voluntary lowering undergo a high-to-low reversal into the destructive abyss.

strongest_changes: The adjacent former/later/thus sequence turns a past destruction into the first instance of a recurring rule for criminals.
The repeated أَلَمْ pattern coordinates destruction with creation, measured placement, and earth's containment of living and dead.
The same former ones are later gathered, so destruction ends their earthly order without making their identity unrecoverable.
Judgment, denial, crime, and recompense recast the focus event as adjudicated precedent rather than indiscriminate force.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package made three otherwise easy-to-miss activations visible: the split ء و ل succession branch, the exact recurrence of ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ as a gatherable group, and the formal alignment of destruction with creation and earth-containment questions.
remaining_uncertainties: The outcome and succession readings of ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ depend on branch activations more distant than its ordinary temporal sense.
The ecological, appetite, and vertical models are coherent analogies but do not establish historical causes of the former peoples' destruction.
The arrow from denial or crime to destruction is supplied by contextual sequencing and recompense language, not stated inside the focus ayah alone.
